title: Production Brief
description: Entry point to the pipeline. Provided by a human or the Signal Intelligence Platform. Contains everything the Executive Producer needs to kick off a production.

production_id.description: Unique identifier for this production. Slug format.

concept.description: Narrative concept. One to three paragraphs. What the film is about.

tone.description: Tonal direction. How the film should feel.

target_runtime_seconds.description: Target runtime in seconds. MVP range: 180-900.

visual_style.description: Visual language directives for the Art Director.

description.description: Prose description of the visual language. Film stock, grain, color palette, lighting philosophy.

reference_films.description: Films or visual works to reference for style.

color_palette.description: Hex codes or color descriptions for the dominant palette.

period.description: Historical period for production design accuracy.

sound_design.description: Sound philosophy for the Sound Designer.

description.description: Prose description of the sound world.

dialogue_density.description: How much spoken dialogue the film contains.

characters.description: Character descriptions for the Screenwriter and Art Director.

description.description: Full character description. Physical appearance, wardrobe, backstory, mannerisms.

props.description: Key props associated with this character that require consistency tracking.

consistency_priority.description: How important visual consistency is for this prop across shots.

vehicles.description: Vehicles or machines that require visual consistency.

screenplay_path.description: Relative path to the screenplay file within the production directory.

test_objectives.description: Specific capabilities this production is designed to test.

budget_cap_usd.description: Hard cap for this film, in US dollars. Retakes count against the same cap.

hero_props.description: Props that must stay consistent. Sidedness stays open until Ron locks it.

decisions.description: Choices the human executive producer has already locked.

featured_product.description: Optional. A product the film may show. Omit it when the film has no placement. The engine does not assume a product.

product.description: The product as this film names it.

also_known_as.description: Other words the script uses for the same product.

placement_intent.description: How the product should sit in the story.

rules.description: What the boards may and may not do with the product.
